name: Helm of Telepathy
description: Allows telepathic communication and reading surface thoughts.

name: Bag of Holding
description: A magical bag capable of holding much more than its size suggests.

name: Ring of Spell Storing
description: Can store up to 5 levels worth of spells for later use.

name: Cloak of Invisibility
description: Grants the wearer the ability to become invisible at will.

name: Wand of Fireballs
description: Casts the Fireball spell using charges stored within.

name: Quaal's Feather Token (Anchor)
description: Creates an immovable anchor when used.

name: Necklace of Fireballs (Three beads)
description: Necklace containing beads that explode as Fireballs when thrown.
